item.title: Alex movelist details revealed for Street Fighter 6 including his new stance with 11 follow-up options
item.description: <p><a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/jan/21/alex-gameplay-trailer-sf6/">Alex finally got his gameplay trailer for Street Fighter 6</a> today, and he's looking quite a bit different than he has in the past.</p> <p>Capcom has now revealed a bunch of new gameplay details for Alex's various moves and mechanics in Street Fighter 6 that'll set him apart from the rest of the roster.</p>

item.title: 2XKO and Twitch hit with backlash for paltry or potentially unpaid 'sponsorship' deal
item.description: <p>After many years of waiting, <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/jan/19/season-1-patch-notes-2xko/">2XKO finally launched in full</a> this week, which of course means that players and content creators around the world are hopping into the League of Legends fighting game.</p> <p>Riot Games has already managed to stir up some controversy with 2XKO, however, the issue doesn't stem from the content of the title itself.</p>

item.title: Is it time for a rework to Mario's moveset? Mod introduces crazy changes to Mario in Super Smash Bros. Ultimate
item.description: <p>Mario has been with the Super Smash Bros. series since the very beginning. This has marked him as one of the "Perfect Attendance Crew" in <a href='https://www.eventhubs.com/moves/ssbu/'>Super Smash Bros. Ultimate</a>.</p> <p>However, Mario's moveset has largely stayed the same over the years with the biggest alteration being the change to his down special from the Mario Tornado to the F.L.U.D.D. While this move has a lot of utility within Mario's moveset, we haven't actually seen the F.L.U.D.

item.title: Season Pass 2 for Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves now available at surprisingly low price, new Legend Edition released

item.title: AEW star Kenny Omega revealed as motion capture actor for Alex in Street Fighter 6 and gave him the wrestler's signature move
item.description: <p>After months of waiting, <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/jan/21/alex-gameplay-trailer-sf6/">Alex finally received his gameplay trailer for Street Fighter 6</a> last night, and he's looking a fair bit different than past titles.</p> <p>Eagle-eyed fans quickly noticed, however, that some of Alex's moves strike a familiar resemblance to a certain pro wrestler, and for good reason.</p>

item.title: Alex's full unique battle theme released for Street Fighter 6 by Japanese band JAM Project
item.description: <p>Alex got his time to shine in the ring last night with <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/jan/21/alex-gameplay-trailer-sf6/">his official gameplay trailer</a>, and now fans can rock out to the tunes we heard a bit of in it.</p> <p>Capcom just released the full <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/moves/sf6/">Street Fighter 6</a> battle theme for the upcoming DLC character with an apt title and unique sound for the game.</p>

item.title: Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage Version 1.08 patch notes released
item.description: <p>This year will hopefully be a big one for Sega and the <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/virtua-fighter/">Virtua Fighter</a> team on multiple fronts with their current game still receiving updates.</p> <p>Sega has now released the Version 1.08 patch notes for Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage though it won't be here for a little while yet.</p>

item.title: Evo Awards 2026 nominees revealed, public voting period is now open
item.description: <p>Last year, the <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/feb/15/evo-awards-show-results/">Evo Awards</a> were held for the first time to celebrate the fighting game community as a whole and of course provide some big announcements too.</p> <p>The organizers of the largest fighting game events in the world are currently preparing to hold the Evo Awards for the second time, and the community will have a say in who shall be celebrated on the big stage.</p>

item.title: Invincible VS to allow players to try out DLC characters for free, new fighter to be announced next week
item.description: <p><a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/jan/08/2026-fighting-games-guide/">2026 is going to be a very busy year for fighting game fans</a>, and <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/invincible-vs/">Invincible VS</a> is going to be the next to step up to the plate.</p> <p>Skybound Games recently made an interesting announcement in regards to Invincible VS' future DLC characters that should please players.</p>
